sloka: श्यामम् रुधिर पर्यन्तम् बभूव परिवेषणम् ।अलात चक्र प्रतिमम् प्रतिगृह्य दिवाकरम् ॥३-२३-३॥
transliteration: śyāmam rudhira paryantam babhūva pariveṣaṇam ।alāta cakra pratimam pratigṛhya divākaram ॥3-23-3॥

translations.english: A dark ring, bloodred in colour appeared on the border of the Sun's orb, dark in the middle. This phenomenon of the Sun appeared like a ring of moving charcoal covering the Sun.
